position: A session rehearsal is not a participant session and must remain local, read-only, and identity-free
headline: Four ordered events prove the session shape while accounts, networks, persistence, and real participation stay absent.
copy: The sandbox accepts only arrival, source open, local reflection, and exit events. It hashes the transcript, then reports that no invitation, participant, network request, durable write, or live session occurred.

postures.title: Session evaluator
postures.copy: Safe and unsafe transcript fixtures are covered.

postures.title: Data mode
postures.copy: Network, persistence, and write routes are disabled.

postures.title: Real participant
postures.copy: The transcript is a rehearsal only.

flow.title: Arrive
flow.copy: Use a pseudonymous identifier and recorded sandbox consent.

flow.title: Read
flow.copy: Open one allowlisted source in read-only mode.

flow.title: Reflect
flow.copy: Record only a local reflection length, never the text.

flow.title: Exit
flow.copy: Close within thirty minutes and hash the transcript.

decisions.label: Transcript contract
decisions.reason: Four events and their order are enforced.

decisions.label: Maximum duration
decisions.reason: The rehearsal cannot become an open session.

decisions.label: Real sessions
decisions.reason: No participant account or invitation exists.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Only pseudonymous identifiers are accepted; direct identity is rejected.

locks.title: Invitation lock
locks.copy: No token, email, delivery, or live invitation is created.

locks.title: Participant lock
locks.copy: No participant account or real session exists.

locks.title: Provider lock
locks.copy: No external provider, notification, or durable participant write is touched.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Private validation cannot open public access.
